label: MacPhail Brook / River Denys confluence
phase: First independent validation of frozen TPS13; never scored or used for model selection
point_definition: Meeting of the drawn water lines, paired with the exact original three-stream WARV50 node; not the road intersection or bridge centre.
identity_evidence: The northern tributary joins the east-west River Denys reach above a westward bend and a downstream southward turn toward Chisholm Bridge. The original named WARV50 network has the same northern MacPhail tributary, east approach, west bend, southward reach, then bridge and separate southwest McLennan confluence. The exact source crosshair is on the three drawn water lines, away from roads and lettering. This is not the downstream IS30 feature.
coverage_limit: Approximately 1.4 km from prior diagnostic IS30 on the same river; one local validation location, not independent regional coverage.
